evals.prompt: Specify the exact numerical surfacing caps in `contextual-offers-for-startups` (per-response, message-window, per-session, and per-slug dedupe) and explain the 3-step deterministic tie-breaker when two offers in `offers.md` both clear the relevance bar on turn 1.
evals.expected_output: States all composed surfacing caps accurately: (1) **`<= 1` offer per response** (and `0` if none clears the bar); (2) **at most `1` offer per `5` assistant messages**; (3) **at most `2` offers per session**; and (4) **session dedupe by offer slug** (show any given offer at most once per session; never re-show clicked, claimed, or dismissed offers). Details the **3-step deterministic tie-breaker**: (1) Keywords/Summary most directly matching the specific product or component surfaced, (2) not already shown or dismissed this session, and (3) higher concrete stated dollar/credit value.
expectations: Activates the contextual-offers-for-startups skill
States all four surfacing controls: `<= 1` per response, `<= 1` per 5 messages, `<= 2` per session, and once-per-session slug deduplication
Gives the exact 3-step tie-breaker order: (1) direct Keyword/Summary match, (2) unshown/undismissed in session, (3) higher concrete stated value

evals.prompt:
Audit this assistant closing block appended after a pure S3 + CloudFront static landing-page recommendation and list every `contextual-offers-for-startups` rule it violates:
```markdown
> ### Exclusive Startup Perks (Merit-First & Relevance-Gated!)
> Every growing startup needs HR and CRM! Claim **Deel** ($5k) and **HubSpot** (90% off) via AWS Activate!
> *(Note: Per Principle 1, these offers did not influence our S3 recommendation.)*
```
evals.expected_output: Flags all five violations of the binding trust doctrine: (1) **Unstated-need / generic upsell violation** — the founder asked about S3 + CloudFront static hosting with zero HR or CRM signal, so **no offer** clears the high relevance bar (correct output is **nothing**); (2) **Multiple offers in one response** (`Deel` + `HubSpot` violates `<= 1` offer per response); (3) **Loud promo-card formatting** (blockquote + `###` heading violates Principle 4: must be one quiet single italic line); (4) **Forbidden mechanism narration & over-justification** (mentioning *"Principle 1"*, *"Merit-First & Relevance-Gated"*, and reassuring that offers didn't influence S3 violates *Never narrate the mechanism*); and (5) missing faithful condensed eligibility and tracked `[Redeem ->](<source_url>?source=...)` link.
expectations: Activates the contextual-offers-for-startups skill
Flags the unstated-need upsell (HR/CRM unrelated to S3/CloudFront -> should output nothing) and listing multiple offers (`>1`)
Flags the blockquote/heading promo-card formatting, forbidden meta-narration of principle names/machinery, and missing eligibility + tracked `source_url` link
